# Access controls

Secure self-hosted and SaaS applications with Cloudflare Access policies

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of pages or to a more detailed `llms.txt` index for a section. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Access controls](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/index.md): Access controls resources and guides for Access.

## Policies

- [Access documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/policies/llms.txt): Authenticate users for self-hosted, SaaS, and private applications, and log every request

## AI controls

- [AI controls documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/ai-controls/llms.txt): Centralize MCP servers behind a single endpoint and apply Access policies to AI tool traffic

## Authenticate coding agents

- [Authenticate coding agents](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/authenticate-agents/index.md): Grant coding agents like Claude Code, OpenCode, and Windsurf access to resources protected by Cloudflare Access using cloudflared or service tokens.

- [Event subscriptions](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/event-subscriptions/index.md): Reference information for Event subscriptions in Access.

## Troubleshoot Access

- [Troubleshoot Access](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/access-controls/troubleshooting/index.md): Resolve common issues with Cloudflare Access, including authentication loops, CORS errors, and identity provider integration problems.
